info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Service API

items.docs: Allows a registered Service Provider to fetch its information from the server.

info.name: Updates an existing Service Provider details

items.docs: Allows a registered Service Provider to update its configuration on the server. A Service Provider should call this API first after the successful creation of the project on Mastercard Developers before they call other APIs.

Allows a registered service provider to add a list of new payment cards to its profile.This endpoint uses [Mastercard payload encryption](https://mstr.cd/2UPfda0). Refer to the [Payload Encryption](https://developer.mastercard.com/carbon-calculator/documentation/tutorials-and-guides/payload-encryption/) page for implementation details.

params.name: payment_card_id
params.description: Unique ID provided in the response while registering a payment card.

items.docs:
Allows a registered Service Provider to delete single Payment Card at a time from its profile. Any data associated with a requested paymentCardId will also be deleted permanently.

On the successful response from the server, a Service Provider should remove all the requested paymentCardIds from the system.

Once a request has been received from a Service Provider, data deletion will happen immediately.
